description:
Create a new Grouped Product in Magento to sell a fitness bundle. 

1. Navigate to Catalog > Products and create a 'Grouped Product'.
2. Configure the product:
   - Product Name: 'Home Gym Starter Kit'
   - SKU: 'HOMEGYM-KIT-001'
   - Status: Enabled
   - Visibility: Catalog, Search
   - Category: 'Sports'

3. In the 'Grouped Products' section, add the following products to the group:
   - 'YOGA-001' (Yoga Mat Premium) - Default Qty: 1
   - 'BOTTLE-001' (Insulated Water Bottle) - Default Qty: 2
   - 'TSHIRT-001' (Classic Cotton T-Shirt) - Default Qty: 1

4. Save the product. 

Note: You may need to log in with admin / Admin1234! if asked.
